user_intent: 期望 声音 处于 59 dB 到 82 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 82 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 59 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_television
